mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) indicates monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 4.0% (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) signals imminent monetary easing, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.0%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 320.0) indicates stable monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 4.0 AND CPIAUCSL < 320.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) triggers anticipated monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed responds to economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate decline (GDPC1 growth rate < -0.5%) signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates weakening economic activity, reducing corporate output and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1.3 million units (HOUST < 1300) signal weak consumer demand, reducing retail sales and corporate revenue, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1300 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 320.0 indicates elevated inflation, prompting monetary tightening that increases discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 320.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
